doc: Hunters drawn on Meshy's own skeleton and clips (scripts/heroes/warden_native.gd, docs/art/wardens/MESHY_NATIVE.md), keyed by art name. meshy_native: the switch (off = the contract model as before; Albert, Cinder, Meeko, Vex are listed off until their <art>_meshy.glb is packed and picked). Size: Meshy's head bone onto the rig's head pivot (WardenNative._fit). file: art/wardens/<art>/<art>_meshy.glb. clips: game state -> Meshy clip. walk_mps/run_mps/crouch_mps: m/s ground speed each loop plays at rate 1; run_from: m/s where the walk hands to the run; attack_rate, jump_rate: play rate of those one-shots. hand: Meshy's bone the weapon's aim node rides. anchors: anchor empty -> the Meshy bone it rides. crouch_arms_from: the crouch plays that state's clip on the arms (the bones below arm_roots, default LeftShoulder and RightShoulder): Meshy's crouch holds a torch out. toon (default true): the game's hero-toon pass on the surfaces. weapon: Meshy's model has none, so the contract model's weapon (its surfaces by material, riding the contract bone) is held as its own piece in Meshy's hand bone (WardenHeld): Kael's sword, Grimble's blunderbuss in his iron fist; its anchor empties ("anchors") come along, so the look's blooms and the kit's FX points ride the held weapon. orbits: orbit node of the contract .glb -> the Meshy bone it rides (the props are copied from <art>.glb and turn as on the contract path: Tenzo's seeing-stones).
